title: Terminal external fetches need a matching CSP connect-src entry
answers: Terminal download blocked by Content Security Policy
Why does the terminal fetch fail with CSP connect-src error?
Add a new external host the frontend can fetch from
body:
The browser fetches terminal archives from raw.githubusercontent.com, which only works because `posthog/middleware.py` CSP `connect-src` lists `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PostHog/terminal-assets/`. The entry is path-scoped so other repos stay unreachable to injected script (same pattern as the api.github.com/repos/PostHog/posthog/ entry).
If `baseUrl` in `frontend/src/scenes/terminal/terminal-packages.json` moves to another repo or host, update the CSP in `posthog/middleware.py` in the same change.
applies: terminal package baseUrl and CSP in posthog/middleware.py
